content.en: Emergency: 999
content.ar: الطوارئ: 999

items.notes: GOV.UK names 999 as the national emergency number; the NHS page says call 999 if life is at risk.

content.en: 112 also works in the UK
content.ar: الرقم 112 يعمل أيضًا في المملكة المتحدة

items.notes: Earlier 4 Nov report also read GOV.UK only for this note.

content.en: First midwife appointment at 8 to 12 weeks.
content.ar: أول موعد مع القابلة بين الأسبوع 8 و12.

items.notes: App says "Week 8". Within the range but narrower than the source.
items.reviewerMustSupply: NICE guideline (second source) and a UK midwife.

content.en: 11 to 14 week scan: checks due date and development; screening for Down's, Edwards' and Patau's syndromes can be offered, and it is her choice.
content.ar: فحص بالموجات فوق الصوتية بين الأسبوع 11 و14: يحدد موعد الولادة ويتحقق من النمو. يمكن عرض فحص متلازمة داون وإدواردز وباتو، والقرار لكِ.

items.notes: App R-A02 and R-A03 (week 10 and week 12) match the 11 to 14 week window only loosely.

content.en: 16 week appointment: previous screening results, blood pressure and urine tests.
content.ar: موعد الأسبوع 16: نتائج الفحوص السابقة وقياس ضغط الدم وفحص البول.

items.notes: App R-A04 adds an "iron check". The NHS page as read does not mention it: unverified.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Source for the iron check, or remove it.

content.en: 18 to 21 week scan (screening scan): checks the baby's development.
content.ar: فحص بين الأسبوع 18 و21: يتحقق من نمو الطفل.

items.notes: App says week 20: inside the range.

content.en: Gestational diabetes test, only if she has a higher chance of it, between 24 and 28 weeks.
content.ar: فحص سكري الحمل، فقط إذا كان احتمال الإصابة أعلى، بين الأسبوع 24 و28.

items.notes: App says week 25: inside the range.

items.topic: appointment pattern depends on whether it is a first baby

content.en: At least 10 appointments for a first baby and at least 7 if she has had a baby before. Weeks 25, 31, 40 and 41 are listed for first babies.
content.ar: عدد المواعيد 10 على الأقل في الحمل الأول و7 على الأقل إذا سبقت لها ولادة. المواعيد في الأسابيع 25 و31 و40 و41 مخصصة للحمل الأول.

items.notes: DIFFERENCE FROM APP: the app shows weeks 24, 31, 40 and 41 for everyone and week 24 where the NHS says 25. The app does not ask whether it is a first baby.

content.en: 28 week appointment: blood test and, if the baby is at risk, an injection for rhesus disease.
content.ar: موعد الأسبوع 28: فحص دم، وحقنة للوقاية من مرض الريسوس إذا كان الطفل معرضًا للخطر.

items.notes: App R-A08 also says "fetal movement awareness" at 28 weeks. On this page, discussing movements is listed at 25 weeks. Reduced-movement advice is a separate safety item (fix-list F-03).

content.en: 34 week appointment (birth preparation, blood pressure, urine). 36 weeks: baby's position checked by feeling the bump. 38 weeks: position check and options if still pregnant after 40 weeks.
content.ar: موعد الأسبوع 34 (التحضير للولادة وضغط الدم والبول). الأسبوع 36: فحص وضع الجنين بالجس. الأسبوع 38: فحص الوضع ومناقشة الخيارات إذا استمر الحمل بعد 40 أسبوعًا.

items.notes: App R-A10 to R-A12 broadly match. The app's "week 36 baby position check, birth plan discussion" and week-38 "signs of labour" differ slightly in wording (fix-list F-10).

content.en: 41 week appointment: options if still pregnant after 41 weeks.
content.ar: موعد الأسبوع 41: مناقشة الخيارات إذا استمر الحمل بعد 41 أسبوعًا.

items.notes: App says "Consultant review". The NHS page as read does not name a consultant. Also the app says a sweep is offered at week 40; not stated on this page.
items.reviewerMustSupply: A UK midwife; NICE induction guidance.

content.en: Whooping cough vaccine: usually at 20 weeks, can be had from 16 weeks, and should be had before 32 weeks. If missed, it can still be given later.
content.ar: لقاح السعال الديكي: يُعطى عادة في الأسبوع 20 ويمكن من الأسبوع 16، ويُفضّل قبل الأسبوع 32. إذا فاتك يمكن إعطاؤه لاحقًا.

items.notes: App R-A10 says "still possible until labour". The page as read says "later" for whooping cough; "up until labour" appears for RSV. Treat "until labour" as unverified. Page review date has lapsed.
items.reviewerMustSupply: A UK midwife; UKHSA/Green Book as second source.

content.en: RSV vaccine: offered around the 28-week appointment; can be given later if needed, up until labour.
content.ar: لقاح الفيروس المخلوي التنفسي: يُعرض في موعد الأسبوع 28 تقريبًا، ويمكن إعطاؤه لاحقًا عند الحاجة حتى بدء المخاض.

items.notes: MISSING FROM APP: no RSV item exists in the reminders. Page review date has lapsed; confirm current policy.
items.reviewerMustSupply: UKHSA programme page; a UK midwife.

content.en: Newborn blood spot (heel prick) test is normally done when the baby is 5 days old; sometimes earlier or later.
content.ar: يُجرى فحص بقعة الدم (وخز الكعب) عادة عندما يبلغ الطفل 5 أيام، وأحيانًا أبكر أو أبعد.

items.notes: DIFFERENCE FROM APP: R-P02 says Day 3.

content.en: Mother's postnatal check 6 to 8 weeks after the birth. The baby should also be checked by a GP at around this time.
content.ar: فحص ما بعد الولادة للأم بعد 6 إلى 8 أسابيع من الولادة. ويُفحص الطفل أيضًا عند طبيب عام في هذا الوقت تقريبًا.

items.notes: App R-P07 says Day 42 (6 weeks). Consistent, but the source gives a window.

content.en: 8 weeks: 6-in-1 (1st), rotavirus (1st), MenB (1st). 12 weeks: 6-in-1 (2nd), MenB (2nd), rotavirus (2nd). 16 weeks: 6-in-1 (3rd), pneumococcal (1st).
content.ar: عمر 8 أسابيع: السداسي (الجرعة 1) والروتا (1) والمكورات السحائية ب (1). عمر 12 أسبوعًا: السداسي (2) والمكورات السحائية ب (2) والروتا (2). عمر 16 أسبوعًا: السداسي (3) والمكورات الرئوية (1).

items.notes: Timing matches app R-P08 to R-P10. The app already labels these as UK. Page review date has lapsed and the schedule changed recently, so re-check before use. Arabic term for 6-in-1 is on the Arabic reviewer list (F-11).
items.reviewerMustSupply: UKHSA Green Book or immunisation schedule PDF as second source.

content.en: Folic acid 400 micrograms a day, ideally from 3 months before conception until week 12 of pregnancy.
content.ar: حمض الفوليك 400 ميكروغرام يوميًا، ويُفضّل من 3 أشهر قبل الحمل حتى الأسبوع 12 من الحمل.

items.notes: Matches app R-S01 and R-S03. App adds "your doctor may advise a different dose": good.

content.en: The NHS says to consider vitamin D 10 micrograms a day between October and March. WHO does not recommend routine vitamin D supplements in pregnancy.
content.ar: تقول هيئة الصحة البريطانية (NHS) إنه يمكن النظر في فيتامين د 10 ميكروغرام يوميًا بين أكتوبر ومارس. ولا توصي منظمة الصحة العالمية بمكملات فيتامين د الروتينية في الحمل.

items.notes: DIFFERENCE FROM APP: R-S04 says "throughout pregnancy" and R-S02/R-S05 say daily without the October to March qualifier (fix-list F-07). The WHO position is from the Egypt pilot (WHO-ANC); not re-read here. Also see policy A2-7.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Pharmacist and UK midwife to decide wording.

content.en: NHS: call 111 and choose the mental health option. Samaritans: 116 123, any time. If life is at risk, call 999 or go to A&E.
content.ar: هيئة الصحة البريطانية: اتصلي بالرقم 111 واختاري خيار الصحة النفسية. منظمة سامريتانز: 116 123 في أي وقت. إذا كانت الحياة في خطر اتصلي بـ 999 أو توجهي إلى الطوارئ.

items.notes: Candidate for the self-harm safety item (fix-list F-04). The page has no postnatal-specific text. These are UK numbers: do not show to users in other countries.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Second source; a UK perinatal mental-health service.

items.topic: where UK pregnancy medicine information comes from

content.en: UKTIS publishes public summaries and leaflets on medicines in pregnancy (medicinesinpregnancy.org). Full monographs are for professionals.
content.ar: تنشر خدمة UKTIS ملخصات ونشرات عامة عن الأدوية أثناء الحمل. والمراجع الكاملة مخصصة للمهنيين.

items.notes: Reference for policy A2-7, not a statement about any medicine. UK service.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Pharmacist to confirm as a tier-2 source.
